title: In the TypeScript build (v19)
body: (kept below, unchanged, because it is the reference every figure is checked against). The TypeScript + React build keeps the same calculation chain but organises it differently:
React components render selectors and call controllers; no business logic in components
Pure engine: curve adapters, kernel, monthly rows, annual rows, canonical payback and NPV
Store subscriptions (zustand) and the audit log
One immutable document (the same keys, so old snapshots still load); every change is a command
Persistence adapters: JSON snapshot, IndexedDB autosave with history, BroadcastChannel
Memoised selectors; no runtime graph, so no full-refresh switch
Command middleware: every change is logged with its label; replay reproduces the state; undo and redo are free
Layers 3-5 (Monte Carlo, Decision, Strategy), the Board and the Factory meta-model are ported section by section in later phases; until then the descriptions below remain the specification.
